Test Case: Content is centered with side gutters
Test Steps:
1. Open Site 1 in Chrome, viewport 1440x900, zoom 100%.
2. Wait until the News section is visible.
3. Locate: News section container.
4. Read the computed values of: max-width, margin, padding-left, padding-right (DevTools Computed tab or getComputedStyle).
5. Repeat steps 1-4 on Site 2 with the same viewport and zoom.
6. Compare Site 1 and Site 2 values and record them.
Expected Result: Left and right gutters are equal on both sites. Values of max-width, margin, padding-left, padding-right match on both sites (numeric tolerance +/-1px).
